text:
Ava: Hey all — quick idea: rooftop silent disco + sandwich spread this Friday at 6pm? Weather looks decent :sun_with_face: We can do a small picnic vibe, bring your own headphones (we'll have a couple of spares). Sign-up + dietary notes: https://docs.google.com/sheet/d/rooftop-signup
Noah: Love it. I'm happy to DJ a short set — mix of indie / 80s / house. Do we want a poll for genres? :headphones:
Maya: Count me in. Can we get vegan options please? I'm allergic to tree nuts though.
Ava: Yep vegan and gluten-free options on the sheet, please mark allergies in the column.
Priya: I'll bring paper plates and a bluetooth speaker for outside (just in case).
Jonah: I'll handle drinks (nonalcoholic + a few beers). Any preferences?
Sam: 2 quick q's — is this fine for families? I might bring my partner. Also, how many people are we aiming for?
Ava: @Sam families are welcome! We're capping at ~35 to keep it cozy. Put +1 in the sheet if you're bringing someone.
Noah: For the poll: react with :one: for indie, :two: for 80s, :three: for house/techno, :four: for mixed.
Maya: :three:
Priya: :four: (mixed)
Jonah: :two:
Sam: :four: 
Ava: Tally so far — indie:0, 80s:1, house:1, mixed:2. Want to keep it varied and rotate playlists every 30 min.
Noah: Cool. I'll make a collaborative playlist, drop link here: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/rooftop-silent-disco
Priya: Heads up — rooftop rules: please bring flat-soled shoes, no smoking. I can post a reminder in #general tomorrow.
calendar-bot: Event created: Rooftop Silent Disco — Friday 6:00 PM to 9:00 PM. RSVP on calendar + see signup sheet.
Ava: Perfect. If anyone wants to volunteer to help set up at 5:15, reply here. :raised_hands:
Jonah: I can help set up tables and lights.
Maya: I'll help with food layout.
Sam: I'll be there a bit early to help with drinks.
Ava: Awesome — thanks everyone. See you Friday! :tada:
